children: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. Sponsored ADR (TSE:8306) is accelerating digital expansion—launching a high‑rate digital bank with seamless branch links, merging robo‑advisor WealthNavi and MUFG eSmart Securities, backing Asian growth funds and IPOs, and pursuing non‑bank partnerships to boost engagement.
Digital Bank Plan To Curb Youth Deposits
: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (8306) plans a digital bank this fiscal year to curb youth deposit outflows. It will offer high rates, easy UX and 24/7 transfers between digital and branch accounts.
MUFG ADR 8306 Merges eSmart With WealthNavi

: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (ADR 8306) to merge MUFG eSmart Securities with WealthNavi, combining robo‑advisory AI and digital banking to expand online securities access and integrated investing.

: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (8306) backs Dragon Funds’ second $600M fund to invest in high-growth India and Asia‑Pacific startups, focusing on financial services, consumer and enterprise sectors.
MUFG ADR 8306 Invests In Mynt IPO
: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (ADR 8306) is an investor in Mynt’s IPO, which plans to offer 8.03 billion shares up to PHP 10 each for the GCash platform.
: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (8306): MUFG Bank CEO Masakazu Osawa says the bank will pursue partnerships with non-financial firms to expand customer touchpoints and boost engagement.
